totalUnits.description: Cannot increase after opening. A reduction may only remove units that have not started.

effectiveEndDate.description: Exclusive Membership end date in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current resource state.

CourseRefundDisbursementConflict.description: A Course refund disbursement conflict. An approved non-immediate refund before Course Run completion uses code COURSE_REFUND_DISBURSEMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE.

BookingConflict.description: A booking conflict, including MEMBERSHIP_BENEFIT_REQUIRED when required Benefits are missing.

MembershipOrderConflict.description: Membership Order creation conflicts with current state; an unavailable Offer uses code MEMBERSHIP_OFFER_NOT_AVAILABLE.

TooManyRequests.description: The request rate limit was exceeded.
